name: "Western Omelet" Frittata with Bacon, Corn, Bell Pepper & Cheddar

instructions.primary_message: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell peppers. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice the peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 red bell pepper
1 green bell pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
2 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are golden and tender, 6-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place eggs and spices in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
¼ tsp paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese and bacon over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!
